title: How I Became The Neighborhood Snack King 🍫
topic: Running a secret snack empire and becoming the CEO of the streets.

lines.speaker: nix
lines.text: Quit searching for your missing chocolate [beat] because I just bought every single candy bar in this entire zip code with my own cash!

lines.speaker: choto
lines.text: Nix, you little corporate monster, my canteen shelves are empty [beat] and these hungry kids are starting a literal snack riot in the halls!

lines.speaker: sam
lines.text: I saw him at three in the morning [beat] unloading heavy crates of spicy chips behind the gym like some kind of high-stakes sugar-smuggler!

lines.speaker: lubna
lines.text: Nix, please explain why our garage is stacked to the ceiling with soda cans [beat] and why the neighbors are calling you 'The Boss' of the block?

lines.speaker: nani
lines.text: Did you really think I wouldn't notice the extra miles on my odometer [beat] or the permanent smell of nacho cheese in my leather seats?

lines.speaker: nix
lines.text: I’m sorry Nani, but the people were starving [beat] and the school cafeteria serves literal flavored cardboard for lunch every single day.

lines.speaker: jamal
lines.text: The boy has real business vision, Lubna [beat] he’s undercut every grocery store price in the city using that modified high-speed engine.

lines.speaker: rafiq
lines.text: So you’ve been running a black-market snack empire [beat] while you were pretending to do your trigonometry homework in your bedroom?

lines.speaker: nix
lines.text: The trigonometry was actually my secret accounting ledger [beat] and my net profits are up four hundred percent since I started deliveries.

lines.speaker: bruno
lines.text: I tried to steal his delivery bag once [beat] but that scooter is faster than a police interceptor and it actually glows in the dark!

lines.speaker: nani
lines.text: Good work, Nix, but remember who owns the fleet [beat] I want a fifty percent cut of the revenue or I am taking the keys back right now.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: And that is how Nix turned a midnight secret into a snack dynasty [beat] proving that the right wheels and a little hustle can rule the streets.
